name: soil_organic_carbon_content
description: Soil organic carbon stock per unit area. min_depth and max_depth give the sampled interval for fixed depth stocks and the reference interval for equivalent soil mass stocks, whose integrated depth is in attributes_json.equivalent_depth_cm where the source reports it.
notes: PEcAn standard_vars soil_organic_carbon_content (kg C m-2); 1 Mg C ha-1 = 0.1 kg C m-2. Replaces SOC_stock_Mg_ha (organization#302). Salinas rows are the Data in Brief block stocks rescaled x0.905 for the White et al. (2024) correction; Russell Ranch rows are raffeld_2024 per plot ESM2 stocks.

name: soil_bulk_density
description: Soil bulk density, dry soil mass per volume. Depth interval in min_depth and max_depth.
notes: No PEcAn.utils::standard_vars name for this quantity. Replaces bulk_density_g_cm3 (organization#302).

name: soil_organic_carbon_concentration
description: Soil organic carbon concentration, mass of C per mass of dry soil. Depth interval in min_depth and max_depth.
notes: Replaces SOC_conc_mg_kg (organization#302).

name: soil_total_carbon_concentration
description: Total soil carbon (organic plus inorganic) concentration, mass per mass of dry soil; the row's method gives the analysis. Distinct from soil organic carbon where carbonates may contribute. Depth interval in min_depth and max_depth, or in attributes_json reported_layer_top_cm and reported_layer_bottom_cm where those are empty.
notes: Replaces total_carbon_pct (Russell Ranch), total_C_pct (Modesto) and soil_carbon_content (AmeriFlux Delta sites; those six rows are concentrations, not the PEcAn per area soil_carbon_content) (organization#302).

name: soil_total_nitrogen_concentration
description: Total soil nitrogen concentration, mass per mass of dry soil; the row's method gives the analysis. Depth interval in min_depth and max_depth, or in attributes_json reported_layer_top_cm and reported_layer_bottom_cm where those are empty.
units: %; % dry weight; mg N kg-1 soil; g kg-1
notes: Replaces total_nitrogen_pct (Russell Ranch), total_N_pct (Modesto), total_N_conc_mg_kg (Salinas) and soil_nitrogen_content (AmeriFlux Delta sites; concentrations, not the PEcAn per area soil_nitrogen_content) (organization#302).

name: soil_organic_matter_concentration
description: Soil organic matter, mass percent of dry soil; Walkley-Black or loss on ignition as given in method.
notes: Replaces soil_organic_matter_pct (organization#302).

name: soil_ammonium_nitrogen_concentration
description: Extractable soil ammonium nitrogen (NH4-N), mass of N per mass of dry soil.
notes: Replaces soil_nh4_n_mg_kg (Russell Ranch, 2M KCl extract) (organization#302).

name: soil_nitrate_nitrogen_concentration
description: Extractable soil nitrate nitrogen (NO3-N), mass of N per mass of dry soil.
units: mg kg-1; mg NO3-N kg-1 soil
notes: Replaces soil_no3_n_mg_kg (Russell Ranch, 2M KCl extract) and nitrate_N_mg_kg (Salinas) (organization#302).

name: grain_dry_yield
description: Grain yield on a dry matter basis. The crop is in the crop column; hand or machine harvest is in method.
notes: PEcAn CropYield (kg m-2) carries no moisture basis, so this name keeps dry matter explicit. Replaces corn_grain_dry_yield_kg_ha, corn_grain_mh_dry_yield_kg_ha and wheat_mh_dry_grain_yield_kg_ha (organization#302). Russell Ranch hand harvested wheat is in the excluded_obs tab, not in observations.

name: aboveground_dry_biomass
description: Aboveground plant dry biomass at sampling, all aboveground parts (corn: grain, cob and stalk; a cover crop: every mixture component). The crop is in the crop column.
notes: Replaces corn_total_biomass_kg_ha and cover_crop_dry_biomass_kg_ha (Russell Ranch, plot level, kg ha-1) and cover_crop_shoot_dry_matter_Mg_ha (Salinas, treatment means read from Brennan and Boyd 2012 Fig. 5, Mg ha-1); 1 Mg ha-1 = 1000 kg ha-1 (organization#302). PEcAn AGB is kg C m-2, a carbon basis these rows do not have.

name: red_fruit_fresh_yield
description: Fresh weight of ripe (red) fruit. The crop is in the crop column.
notes: Replaces tomato_red_fresh_yield_Mg_ha, hand harvest at Russell Ranch (organization#302).

name: green_fruit_fresh_yield
description: Fresh weight of unripe (green) fruit. The crop is in the crop column.
notes: Replaces tomato_green_fresh_yield_Mg_ha, hand harvest at Russell Ranch; green fruit stays in the field (organization#302).

name: vine_dry_biomass
description: Dry biomass of the vines (stems and leaves) left after the fruit is removed.
notes: Replaces tomato_vine_dry_yield_Mg_ha, hand harvest at Russell Ranch (organization#302).

name: fruit_dry_yield
description: Fruit yield on a dry matter basis. The crop is in the crop column.
notes: Replaces tomato_mh_dry_yield_Mg_ha, the machine harvested strip at Russell Ranch (organization#302).

name: harvested_dry_biomass
description: Dry biomass of a forage cutting (alfalfa, sudangrass). The crop is in the crop column.
notes: Replaces alfalfa_dry_yield_kg_ha and sudangrass_dry_yield_kg_ha (organization#302). Russell Ranch 1993 sudangrass is the air dry weight of baled hay; the 2008 and 2009 sudangrass was sampled before plowing under and no hay was removed (Wolf et al. 2018 metadata).

name: CH4_flux
description: Methane flux from an authoritative upstream product or publication. Mass basis and measurement support vary by source: reported_units gives the basis, method gives tower or chamber.
notes: Kept in the published basis, not converted. g C m-2 yr-1 = CH4-C (FLUXNET-CH4 Appendix B2 Ann_Flux_g_C_m-2, tower annual totals). mg CH4 m-2 yr-1 / y-1 = CH4 mass (automated chamber annual means, Anthony et al. 2023 Table 1; Anthony and Silver 2021 Table 1). PEcAn CH4_flux is kg C m-2 s-1; convert CH4 mass to CH4-C downstream by 12.011/16.043. Tower and chamber values are not interchangeable; the chamber rows aggregate the same records as anthony_bouldin_2024. Also carries the Bouldin automated chamber annual means of daily flux per chamber (mg CH4 m-2 d-1, anthony_bouldin_2024), formerly CH4_flux_mg_m2_d (organization#302).
